digest.component_or_area: Documentation and comment standards across repository
propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation and source comments must validate conformance to operator standards including punctuation rules, formal voice, paragraph structure, and filler elimination.
Fifty foundation and remediation items span external documentation, internal records, shipped help, developer comments, and embedded prose across maintained files and generated outputs.
Three-shard exploration with specialized filtering must establish evidence basis, prevent duplication, and ensure factual accuracy before any project file changes.
Generated artifacts and their canonical sources require ownership registry, verification protocol, and lifecycle definitions to prevent drift and coordinate updates across documentation families.

Documentation policy must define audience matrices, lifecycle rules, canonical sources, citation practices, historical correction procedures, and authoring-time validation boundaries without mechanical enforcement of prose characteristics.
